ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The question asks for the reproductive barrier that is not pre-zygotic and instead occurs after zygote formation because the offspring cannot reproduce. Pre-zygotic barriers act before fertilization, while post-zygotic barriers act after fertilization and include problems with hybrid viability or fertility. Offspring being unable to reproduce corresponds to hybrid sterility, also phrased as sterility of offspring.
